thread:
sam: FYI support passed a user who completed the quickstart but their very first SDK call returned 402 and they couldn't proceed.

irene: Yikes. Do we have the raw response? 402 normally means billing setup not complete.

sam: From our proxy logs: {status:402, message:"billing_required", request_id:"req_onb_555", workspace_id:"ws_99"} — the client showed a generic "Request failed with status code 402" and retried once. No helpful hint.

lee: That retry makes it look transient. We should treat 402 as an onboarding error in the SDKs and avoid retrying. Also include a help_url with the org billing link.

sam: Repro steps I used: clone quickstart, set REDWOOD_KEY to user key, `yarn dev`, open demo in incognito, click send -> 402.

irene: Two more things: (1) local dev proxies (vercel dev / netlify dev) sometimes strip `x-workspace-id` so the request can land in another workspace and trigger billing unexpectedly; (2) samples print only an axios stacktrace. We should print a clear dev-mode warning when workspace header is missing.

lee: Action items:
- SDK change: map HTTP 402 -> OnboardingBillingError, non-retriable, attach `help_url` pointing at https://app.redwood.ai/orgs/<org>/billing (lee will open PR, 48h).
- Samples: detect missing `x-workspace-id` and console.warn with quick remediation (cora will patch sample server and README today).
- Docs: add a short troubleshooting snippet to quickstart README that shows the exact error payload and a step to check workspace billing in the console (irene, 1d).

onboard-bot: Suggested DM to users who hit 402: "It looks like your organization needs to complete billing setup. See https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/billing for next steps." :wave:

sam: Also please add a Sentry grouping key for onboarding 402s (group by `onboarding_billing`) and include `request_id` and `workspace_id` as breadcrumbs, but never log keys or tokens.

lee: I'll include a unit test in the SDK PR to assert the error object contains `help_url` and is not retried. I'll also add a note to the changelog.

cora: Pushing the sample warning now. I'll add a snippet: ```js
if (!req.headers['x-workspace-id']) {
  console.warn('Missing x-workspace-id. If using Vercel/Netlify dev CLI, enable header forwarding or run the server without the proxy.');
}
```

irene: Great. Support will DM the affected user with the docs link in the meantime. If they remain blocked we can trigger a billing invite from the console.

sam: Thanks team. Hopefully this reduces first-call confusion and support volume. :thumbsup:
